before.en: # Job constraints and participation costs define firm data-centre demand response
before.zh: # 作业约束与参与成本决定数据中心的可靠需求响应能力

after.en: # Workload timing limits reliable demand response from AI data centres
after.zh: # 工作量的时间分布限制人工智能数据中心的可靠需求响应

before.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could support electricity grids by postponing computing, but operators must choose commitments that preserve service through repeated calls. Here we link workload permissions to independently tested response offers and their participation costs. A production resource-time audit informs scenarios with 5–20% of work eligible, which support single-event offers of 2.95–11.80 kW for modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. Using a controller that enforces every recovery obligation, we then vary offered utilisation, deadlines and call schedules. At 10% eligibility, requiring zero deadline loss instead of a 1% allowance reduces the selected eight-hour repeated offer from 4.42 to 2.95 kW in the reference comparison. With submission timing from eight production weeks, these requests succeed in 63/80 and 80/80 synthetic realisations, respectively. Increasing flexible GPU allocation does not restore the larger request. Fixed site fees explain about 95% of the original four-hour participation threshold, yet removing them leaves distinct operating costs for qualified duration products. The resulting evidence supports choosing a service standard and call commitment together, then pricing that specific offer; neither workload eligibility nor a low access cost is sufficient.
before.zh: 人工智能数据中心可以通过推迟计算为电网提供支持，但运营者必须选择能够在重复调用中维持任务服务的响应承诺。本文将工作参与许可与独立检验的响应报价及其参与成本连接起来。生产资源时间审计为 5–20% 工作可延后的情景提供依据；这些情景在约 190–200 kW 的模型运行峰值下，支持 2.95–11.80 kW 的单次响应报价。随后，我们使用执行全部恢复义务的控制器，改变工作供给利用率、期限和调用安排。在 10% 工作可延后的参考比较中，将期限违约容忍度从 1% 收紧到零，使选出的八小时重复响应承诺由 4.42 降至 2.95 kW。采用八个生产周的提交时序后，两档请求分别在 63/80 和 80/80 次合成实现中成功；增加灵活工作池的 GPU 分配未能恢复较大请求的表现。固定场站费用解释了原四小时参与门槛的约 95%，但取消这一费用后，合格时长产品的运行成本仍然不同。因此，应共同选择任务服务标准和调用承诺，再为该具体报价定价；仅有工作参与许可或较低接入费用都不足以确定可行的参与方案。

after.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could help electricity grids accommodate growing demand by postponing computing, provided that response commitments preserve service. Here we connect workload permissions to independently tested offers, workload-timing limits and participation costs. A production resource-time audit informs scenarios with 5–20% of work eligible, supporting single-event offers of 2.95–11.80 kW at modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. At 10% eligibility, locally refined four- and eight-hour repeated offers of 5.60 and 4.42 kW qualify under a zero-deadline-loss standard. Same-scenario feasibility tests distinguish immediate power shortage, deadline constraints and a gap between causal control and perfect-information scheduling. Crucially, an offer that transfers under submission-count profiles can fail when observed task resource-time weights are restored: a fixed 2.95-kW request succeeds in 80/80 count-weighted but only 31/80 resource-time-weighted realisations across eight production weeks, despite service-feasible no-response baselines. Operating ledgers then identify conditional compensation boundaries between qualified duration products. These findings show why operators must validate the temporal supply of reducible power, alongside task service and recovery obligations, before transferring a model-qualified commitment to another workload.
after.zh: 人工智能数据中心可以通过推迟计算，帮助电网应对不断增长的需求，前提是响应承诺能够维持计算服务。本文将工作参与许可与独立检验的报价、工作时序限制和参与成本联系起来。生产资源时间审计为 5%–20% 工作可参与的情景提供依据；在约 190–200 kW 的模型运行峰值下，单次事件合格报价为 2.95–11.80 kW。当工作参与比例为 10% 时，局部加密后的四小时和八小时重复报价分别为 5.60 和 4.42 kW，均通过零期限违约标准的资格检验。同场景可行性对照区分了即时功率不足、期限约束，以及因果控制与完美信息调度之间的差距。关键在于，能够适用于提交次数曲线的报价，在恢复真实任务资源时间权重后可能失败：对八个生产周，固定 2.95 kW 请求在次数加权下成功 80/80，而在资源时间加权下仅为 31/80，尽管无响应基线全部满足服务要求。随后，运行账本给出合格时长产品之间的条件性补偿边界。这些发现说明，将模型内合格的承诺用于另一种工作负载前，运营者需要同时核验可削功率的时间分布、任务服务与恢复义务。

before.en: Here we assess which computing commitments an operator can support, and at what conditional cost. A production execution audit informs scenarios with 5%, 10% or 20% of work permitted to wait; 40% and 60% comparisons expose the additional participation and business-composition assumptions needed for larger flexibility. AIDRBench combines trace-informed jobs, four-GPU power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. We distinguish full-information planning from independent causal-controller tests, then examine corrected recovery control under changed utilisation, deadlines and call histories. A separate timing test preserves the order of submissions from eight production weeks.<sup>28</sup> Finally, complete operating ledgers separate the costs of service delivery from fixed access fees and compare compensation for qualified duration products. These steps turn a workload permission into a testable choice of service standard, capacity and call arrangement.
before.zh: 本文研究运营者能够支持哪些计算负荷响应承诺，以及这些承诺在给定假设下需要多少补偿。生产执行记录审计为 5%、10% 或 20% 工作获准等待的情景提供依据；40% 和 60% 对照则揭示更大灵活性需要额外的参与和业务结构假设。AIDRBench 将轨迹启发的作业、四 GPU 功率测量与社区电力模型结合起来。我们区分完整未来信息下的规划与因果控制器的独立检验，再用修正后的恢复控制，研究利用率、期限和调用历史变化。另一个时序检验保留了八个生产周的提交顺序。<sup>28</sup> 最后，完整运行账本将服务交付成本与固定接入费用分开，比较合格时长产品需要的补偿。这些步骤将工作参与许可转化为可以检验的服务标准、容量和调用安排选择。

after.en: Here we examine how an operator should choose a response commitment when eligible work, task timing and recovery obligations impose different limits. A production execution audit informs 5%, 10% and 20% work-permission scenarios; larger comparisons make the additional business assumptions explicit. AIDRBench combines trace-informed jobs, four-GPU board-power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. We independently test causal-controller offers, refine the reference duration products and use same-scenario perfect-information feasibility checks to interpret failures. Matched tests across eight observed production weeks then separate submission counts from submitted task resource-time.<sup>28</sup> Complete operating ledgers expose the waiting and service-loss quantities behind conditional compensation. Together, these comparisons identify when to revise the controller, reconsider task permissions or withhold a commitment from a changed workload.
after.zh: 本文研究：当可参与工作、任务时序和恢复义务施加不同限制时，运营者应如何选择响应承诺。生产执行数据审计为 5%、10% 和 20% 工作许可情景提供依据，更高比例的对照则明确其额外业务假设。AIDRBench 结合受轨迹约束的作业、四块 GPU 的板卡功率测量与社区电力系统模型。我们独立检验因果控制器的报价，加密参考时长产品，并通过同场景完美信息可行性对照解释失败。随后，八个实际生产周的配对测试区分提交次数与提交任务的资源时间。<sup>28</sup> 完整运行账本展示条件性补偿背后的等待与服务损失量。共同来看，这些对照帮助区分何时应改进控制器、重新考虑任务许可，或暂缓将承诺用于改变后的工作负载。

before.en: Limiting eligible work constrained the response. Under perfect information (PI), where the scheduler knows all future arrivals, four-hour planning lower bounds were 2.89, 5.78 and 11.56 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. Development-selected offers of 2.95, 5.90 and 11.80 kW then qualified on 300 independent scenarios, corresponding to 1.6–5.9% of the configurations' operating peaks (Fig. 2a; Supplementary Table 4). The 40% and 60% comparisons qualified at 22.19 and 34.00 kW under their additional assumptions. The proportional low-share response follows the shared job-template scaling and allocation policy; it is not an empirically established linear law for production facilities.

before.en: ### Service requirements and workload timing change the repeated commitment
before.zh: ### 任务服务要求与工作时序改变可重复调用的承诺

after.en: ### Workload timing determines whether a repeated commitment transfers
after.zh: ### 工作量的时间分布决定重复承诺能否适用

before.en: We next tested repeated commitments after correcting the controller to enforce every overlapping recovery window. The earlier repair also benefited a greedy policy, so it established an implementation requirement rather than an MPC-specific advantage (Supplementary Fig. 3a; Supplementary Tables 10–12). The new comparison held eligibility at 10% and varied offered utilisation from 50% to 80%, with reference or halved deadline slack and selected GPU-allocation controls. Four eight-hour calls were tested at 16- or 24-h start spacing. Anchoring the final call at the same randomly chosen hour allowed a matched single-call check while retaining different preceding call histories.
before.zh: 接下来，我们在控制器已经能够执行全部重叠恢复窗口约束的前提下，检验重复响应承诺。此前的修复同样改善了贪心策略，因而说明的是实现必须满足的要求，不能证明 MPC 独有的优势（补充图 3a；补充表 10–12）。新比较固定 10% 的工作可延后，将工作供给利用率设为 50–80%，采用参考期限或减半的期限余量，并加入指定的 GPU 分配对照。四次八小时调用的开始间隔为 16 或 24 h。将最后一次调用固定在相同的随机时刻，可以在保留不同先前调用历史的同时，与单独调用进行配对核对。

before.en: The supported offer depended on the task-service requirement. At 65% offered utilisation and reference deadlines, the development-selected request for 16-h start spacing was 4.42 kW with at most 1% missed eligible work, but 2.95 kW with zero missed work; independent confirmation yielded 299/300 and 300/300 successes, respectively (Fig. 3a). Across the full structural grid, all 26 positive endpoint-specific selections passed confirmation; eight combinations selected no candidate (Supplementary Table 14). Retrospective zero-miss scoring left the earlier 30 selected offers’ success counts unchanged, but reduced the unselected full eight-hour comparison at 10% eligibility from 294/300 to 288/300, below the probability-bound qualification rule (Supplementary Table 13). Zero loss therefore changes some operating choices, rather than imposing a universal derating.
before.zh: 可支持的报价取决于任务服务要求。在 65% 工作供给利用率和参考期限下，开始间隔 16 h 的方案若允许最多 1% 的可参与工作期限违约，开发集选出的请求为 4.42 kW；若要求零期限违约，则为 2.95 kW。两者在独立确认中分别成功 299/300 和 300/300 次（图 3a）。在完整结构网格中，按不同服务终点选出的 26 个正容量候选全部通过确认，另外八个组合没有选出候选（补充表 14）。对原有结果进行零违约重评分时，先前 30 个已选报价的成功计数没有改变；但 10% 情景中未被选中的全额八小时对照由 294/300 降至 288/300，未达到概率下界判定规则（补充表 13）。因此，零损失要求会改变部分运营选择，并不对应统一的容量折减比例。

after.en: We held work eligibility at 10% and tested four calls with a controller that enforces every overlapping recovery obligation. In the reference configuration—65% offered utilisation, reference deadlines and a 10% GPU pool—local refinement at 0.295-kW steps selected 5.60 kW for four-hour calls and 4.42 kW for eight-hour calls, both with 16-h start spacing. Under zero missed work, independent confirmation gave 297/300 and 296/300 successes, with one-sided 95% probability lower bounds of 0.9752 and 0.9706 (Fig. 3a). The 1% and zero-loss endpoints selected the same capacities. The earlier coarse-grid difference between those standards was therefore not a stable reference-capacity penalty (Supplementary Tables 14 and 18).
after.zh: 我们固定 10% 工作可参与，使用落实每项重叠恢复义务的控制器测试四次调用。在参考配置下，即工作供给利用率 65%、参考期限与 10% GPU 池，按约 0.295 kW 的步长局部加密后，四小时和八小时调用分别选择 5.60 和 4.42 kW，开始间隔均为 16 h。按零漏期工作标准，独立确认分别成功 297/300 和 296/300，单侧 95% 概率下界为 0.9752 和 0.9706（图 3a）。1% 与零损失终点选择了相同容量。因此，早期粗网格中两种标准的差别不能作为稳定的参考容量惩罚（补充表 14、18）。

before.en: At the unchanged 5.90-kW request, immediate reducible power was insufficient in 203/300 low-utilisation programmes with 16-h spacing, versus 2/300 at 80% utilisation. Halving deadline slack instead caused more than 1% of work to miss its deadline in all 300 programmes at each utilisation (Fig. 3b). Doubling flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% did not restore that full request. Yet the final call’s electrical outcome was identical to its same-clock isolated counterpart in every structural comparison (Supplementary Fig. 3b). These results distinguish a necessary instantaneous supply limit from episode-wide service pressure; they do not show that accumulated work inevitably degrades the next electrical response. Nor did longer spacing consistently improve the selected offer, because preceding calls also moved to different hours.
before.zh: 在不变的 5.90 kW 请求下，16 h 开始间隔的低利用率方案有 203/300 次因当前可削减功率不足而受限，而 80% 利用率下仅为 2/300 次。将期限余量减半后，每档利用率的全部 300 次方案都出现了超过 1% 的工作期限违约（图 3b）。把灵活工作池的 GPU 分配从 10% 加倍到 20%，未能恢复该全额请求。然而，所有结构对照中，最后一次调用的电力侧结果都与相同时刻的孤立调用完全相同（补充图 3b）。这些结果区分了瞬时可供功率这一必要限制与整个运行阶段的任务服务压力，不能证明积累的工作必然削弱下一次电力响应。更长的开始间隔也未持续提高选出的报价，因为先前调用同时移动到了不同小时。

after.en: Failure diagnosis required a separate feasibility test. At the unchanged 5.90-kW request, selected same-scenario comparisons revealed three distinct limits (Fig. 3b; Supplementary Table 19). Some baseline hours contained too little flexible power to supply 95% of the request even with all flexible execution stopped. In a reference scenario that passed this necessary condition, the causal controller failed but a full-information schedule met every electrical obligation with zero missed work. Halving that scenario’s deadline slack made the request infeasible under the same delivery and recovery criteria; doubling GPU allocation did not restore feasibility. The broader structural tests also retained an unchanged electrical outcome for the last call when earlier calls were removed at a matched clock time (Supplementary Fig. 3; Supplementary Table 15). Thus, neither a controller failure nor a repeated-call failure alone identifies the underlying capacity limit.
after.zh: 解释失败需要单独检验可行性。在保持 5.90 kW 请求不变的同场景对照中，我们辨明三种不同限制（图 3b；补充表 19）。一些基线小时中的灵活功率过少，即使全部停止灵活执行，也无法交付请求的 95%。在通过这一必要条件的一个参考场景中，因果控制器失败，但完整未来信息下存在满足全部电力义务且零漏期的调度。将同一场景的期限余量减半后，在相同交付与恢复判据下请求变为不可行；GPU 分配加倍也未恢复可行性。更广泛的结构检验还保留了一个结果：在对齐时刻后，去掉先前调用并不改变末次调用的电力结果（补充图 3；补充表 15）。因此，仅凭控制器失败或重复调用失败，都不能判定其背后的容量限制。

before.en: The larger offer was also sensitive to temporal structure. Applying the frozen 4.42-kW request to chronologically ordered submissions from eight production weeks gave 63/80 successful synthetic realisations, compared with 76/80 after permuting whole hourly blocks within each week. The 2.95-kW zero-miss request succeeded in all 80 realisations under either ordering (Fig. 3c). Doubling GPU allocation retained 63/80 at the larger chronological request. Permutation was not uniformly beneficial at other tested requests (Supplementary Table 16). These eight-week comparisons preserve observed submission timing while retaining synthetic work sizes and deadlines; they test transfer under a changed structure, not production service-level compliance.
before.zh: 较大报价还对时间结构敏感。将冻结的 4.42 kW 请求应用于八个生产周按原序排列的提交时序，在 80 次合成实现中成功 63 次；将各周内的完整小时块置乱后，成功 76 次。2.95 kW 的零违约请求在两种顺序下均为 80/80 成功（图 3c）。GPU 分配加倍后，较大请求在原序下仍为 63/80。对于其他测试请求，置乱并非总能改善结果（补充表 16）。这一八周比较保留真实提交时序，但工作量和期限仍由合成规则给定；它检验的是结构改变后的适用性，不是生产服务等级协议的履约证明。

after.en: The timing tests locate a further transfer limit. In the earlier eight-week submission-count test, the 4.42-kW request succeeded in 63/80 chronological realisations under either the 1% or zero-loss score; every one of its 17 failures triggered immediate supply shortage. At 2.95 kW, both scores gave 80/80 (Fig. 3c). In a new matched test, replacing hourly job counts with observed task resource-time weights reduced success at the unchanged 2.95-kW request from 80/80 to 31/80; the remaining 49 realisations all encountered immediate shortage. At 4.42 kW, every resource-time-weighted chronological realisation encountered shortage and failed, whereas count weighting gave 61/80 successes at 1% and 60/80 at zero loss (Fig. 3d). All no-response baselines met the zero-loss service criterion. These comparisons held weekly work totals fixed: temporal concentration and low-supply hours, rather than total eligible work or an infeasible baseline, prevented transfer (Supplementary Table 20).
after.zh: 时序测试揭示了进一步的适用边界。在早期八周提交次数测试中，4.42 kW 请求在原序下按 1% 或零损失评分均成功 63/80，其余 17 次失败全部触及即时供给不足；2.95 kW 在两种评分下均为 80/80（图 3c）。在新的配对测试中，将逐小时任务次数替换为实际任务资源时间权重后，同一个 2.95 kW 请求的成功数从 80/80 降至 31/80，其余 49 次全部出现即时不足。4.42 kW 在资源时间加权的全部原序实现中均触及不足并失败，而次数加权下按 1% 和零损失分别成功 61/80、60/80（图 3d）。所有无响应基线均满足零损失服务标准。这些比较保持各周工作总量不变：阻止结果适用的是时间上的集中与供给低谷，而非总可参与工作量或本身不可行的基线（补充表 20）。

before.en: At fixed 10% eligibility, increasing the flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% or 30% left the four- and eight-hour PI bounds at 5.78 and 5.57 kW (Fig. 5a). The unchanged 5.90-kW controller offer also retained 295/300 and 292/300 successes. Extra processing headroom did not supply extra eligible arrivals at the call time. This isolates the allocation effect around the low-eligibility configuration and prevents the primary matching rule from being mistaken for a pure eligibility-only experiment.
before.zh: 固定 10% 资格时，将灵活 GPU 分配由 10% 增至 20% 或 30%，四/八小时 PI 下界仍为 5.78 和 5.57 kW（图 5a）。不变的 5.90 kW 控制器承诺也保持 295/300 和 292/300 的成功数。额外处理余量没有增加调用时已释放的合格工作。这一对照在低资格配置附近单独识别分配影响，避免将主体匹配规则误认为纯资格单因素实验。

after.en: At fixed 10% eligibility, increasing the flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% or 30% left the four- and eight-hour relaxed PI statistics at 5.78 and 5.57 kW (Fig. 5a). The unchanged 5.90-kW controller offer also retained 295/300 and 292/300 successes. Extra processing headroom did not supply extra eligible arrivals at the call time. This isolates the allocation effect around the low-eligibility configuration and prevents the primary matching rule from being mistaken for a pure eligibility-only experiment.
after.zh: 固定 10% 资格时，将灵活 GPU 分配由 10% 增至 20% 或 30%，四/八小时 放松 PI 统计量仍为 5.78 和 5.57 kW（图 5a）。不变的 5.90 kW 控制器承诺也保持 295/300 和 292/300 的成功数。额外处理余量没有增加调用时已释放的合格工作。这一对照在低资格配置附近单独识别分配影响，避免将主体匹配规则误认为纯资格单因素实验。

before.en: We priced each qualified offer from its complete response and recovery ledger. The payment threshold makes the fifth percentile of annual net value non-negative at stated prices and a proportional 1-MW accounting scale. In the original 10% eligibility, four-hour single-event case, US$819.90 of the US$863.26 per offered kW-year threshold came from the assumed US$25,000 annual site fee: about 95% (Fig. 6a). The strong low-eligibility penalty was therefore primarily fixed-cost allocation. Removing that fee left US$43.36 per kW-year in net operating exposure; reserve and displaced-value assumptions remain separate sensitivities (Supplementary Tables 7 and 9).
before.zh: 我们根据每个合格报价的完整响应及恢复账本定价。参与门槛是在指定价格与按比例折算的 1 MW 核算规模下，使年度净值第五百分位不低于零的补偿。在原有 10% 工作可延后、四小时单次响应情景中，每报价千瓦每年 863.26 美元的门槛里，有 819.90 美元来自假设的每年 25,000 美元固定场站费用，占约 95%（图 6a）。因此，低参与比例下较高的单位门槛主要来自固定成本分摊。取消这一费用后，净运行成本门槛为每千瓦每年 43.36 美元；备用容量与假定被挤占业务价值另作敏感性分析（补充表 7、9）。

after.en: Access and operating costs answer different participation questions. In the original 10% eligibility, four-hour single-event case, US$819.90 of the US$863.26 per offered kW-year threshold came from the assumed US$25,000 annual site fee—about 95% (Supplementary Table 17). That low-eligibility unit-cost penalty was primarily fee allocation. We therefore compared the complete response-and-recovery ledgers of the newly qualified duration products separately from access charges. All amounts use a proportional 1-MW accounting scale and retain failed confirmation trajectories.
after.zh: 接入成本与运行成本回答不同的参与问题。在原有 10% 工作可参与、四小时单次事件情景中，每报价 kW 每年 863.26 美元的门槛，有 819.90 美元来自假定的每年 25,000 美元场站费用，约占 95%（补充表 17）。这一低参与比例下的单位成本惩罚主要由费用分摊造成。因此，我们将新合格时长产品的完整响应与恢复账本同接入费用分开比较。全部金额按比例折算至 1 MW 核算规模，且保留确认中的失败轨迹。

before.en: Zero or shared fees did not eliminate the operating distinction between the new qualified products. At reference utilisation and deadlines, the zero-miss four-hour programme offered 4.42 kW, whereas both eight-hour programmes offered 2.95 kW. With no fixed fee, their thresholds were US$174.54, 321.09 and 401.72 per offered accounting kW-year for four-hour/16-h, eight-hour/16-h and eight-hour/24-h duration/start-spacing combinations, respectively (Fig. 6b,c; Supplementary Table 17). All used twelve independent four-call series per year. These differences reflect complete-series operating exposure and selected capacity, rather than a site charge divided by a smaller offer.
before.zh: 零固定费用或共享费用并未消除新合格产品之间的运行差异。在参考利用率和期限下，零违约四小时方案报价为 4.42 kW，两种八小时方案均为 2.95 kW。取消固定费用后，对于“时长/开始间隔”为四小时/16 h、八小时/16 h 和八小时/24 h 的三个组合，门槛依次为每核算报价千瓦每年 174.54、321.09 和 401.72 美元（图 6b,c；补充表 17）。三者均按每年十二组相互独立的四次调用核算。这些差异来自完整调用组的运行负担与选定容量，而非固定场站费用除以较小报价。

after.en: For the locally refined zero-loss products, mean additional waiting exposure per four-call series was 16,491 GPU-h×h for four-hour calls and 24,509 GPU-h×h for eight-hour calls (Fig. 6a; Supplementary Table 21). These are quantities to be valued by the operator. At the illustrative waiting price of US$0.005/GPU-h/h and twelve independent series per year, the no-fixed-fee thresholds were US$183.30 and 330.11 per offered accounting kW-year, respectively (Fig. 6b,c). Their capacity difference and waiting exposure explain the conditional cost comparison; neither has been measured as an operator’s willingness to accept.
after.zh: 对局部加密后的零损失产品，每组四次调用的平均额外等待暴露，四小时产品为 16,491 GPU-h×h，八小时产品为 24,509 GPU-h×h（图 6a；补充表 21）。这些是需要运营者定价的运行量。在示例等待价格每 GPU-h 每小时 0.005 美元、每年十二组独立序列下，无固定费补偿门槛分别为每报价核算 kW 每年 183.30 和 330.11 美元（图 6b,c）。所选容量的差别与等待暴露解释了这一条件性成本比较；两者均未被测量为运营者的实际接受意愿。

before.en: A common site fee changes whether to enter, but cancels when comparing the annual net values of two participating options. At an illustrative equal capacity price of US$250 per kW-year and no site fee, the reference zero-miss four-hour programme had a fifth-percentile annual net value of US$1,726; the eight-hour programme at the same 16-h spacing had −US$1,084 (Supplementary Fig. 5c). For the latter to match the former conditional on participation, its capacity price must equal 1.5 times the four-hour price plus US$59.28 per kW-year. The additional requirement to outperform opting out defines the full price boundary (Fig. 6d). Sharing the original site fee among five or ten resources lowers access costs, but does not establish portfolio reliability or remove this operating tradeoff.
before.zh: 共同的场站费用会改变是否进入市场，但在比较两个参与方案的年度净值时会相互抵消。示例中，若两种产品的容量价格均为每千瓦每年 250 美元且无固定场站费用，参考零违约四小时方案的年度净值第五百分位为 1,726 美元；同为 16 h 开始间隔的八小时方案则为 −1,084 美元（补充图 5c）。在选择参与的条件下，后者要达到前者的净值，其容量价格必须等于四小时价格的 1.5 倍，再加每千瓦每年 59.28 美元；同时优于不参与的要求构成完整价格边界（图 6d）。将原场站费用分摊给五个或十个资源会降低接入成本，但并不证明组合可靠性，也不会消除这一运行取舍。

after.en: At equal illustrative capacity prices of US$250 per kW-year and zero site fee, the four-hour product’s fifth-percentile annual net value was US$1,932, compared with −US$1,832 for eight hours. For the eight-hour product to match the four-hour product conditional on participation, its price must exceed 1.267 times the four-hour price plus US$97.93 per kW-year; the full boundary also requires non-negative net value (Fig. 6d). The coefficient follows the refined capacity ratio, replacing the coarse-grid value of 1.5. When waiting has no incremental price, the equal-price ranking reverses below approximately US$25.57 per kW-year (Supplementary Fig. 5). A shared fee can change whether either option beats non-participation, but a common fee cancels between participating products.
after.zh: 在两种产品容量价格均为每 kW 每年 250 美元、且没有场站费的示例下，四小时产品的年度净值第五百分位为 1,932 美元，八小时为 −1,832 美元。若比较两种参与方案，八小时产品价格须超过四小时价格的 1.267 倍再加每 kW 每年 97.93 美元，才能优于四小时；完整边界还要求净值非负（图 6d）。该系数来自加密后的所选容量比，替代粗网格中的 1.5。当等待没有增量价格时，等价支付下的产品排序在约每 kW 每年 25.57 美元以下反转（补充图 5）。共享费用可以改变某种产品是否优于不参与，但两个参与产品承担的共同费用在相互比较时抵消。

before.en: These are conditional participation screens. All confirmation trajectories, including failures, enter the accounts; waiting and missed-work prices are varied separately from access fees (Supplementary Fig. 5). Contract-specific non-performance penalties, checkpoint costs and actual hardware ageing remain unpriced. Independent annual series do not reproduce a continuously operating year, and lower calculated cost cannot make an unqualified request an offerable product.
before.zh: 这些结果是条件性参与筛选。核算保留全部确认轨迹，包括失败轨迹；等待与期限违约工作的价格分别于接入费用之外进行变化（补充图 5）。合同规定的不履约罚款、检查点成本与真实硬件老化尚未定价。年度核算中的独立调用组不等于连续运行的一年，较低的计算成本也不能使未通过资格检验的请求成为可报价产品。

after.en: The economic result is a price-dependent choice among services qualified for the reference scenario distribution. The failed resource-time transfer prevents treating those prices as offers for the observed-week workload. Waiting and missed-work valuations are varied explicitly; contract penalties, application checkpoint costs and actual hardware ageing remain unpriced. Independent annual series provide a conditional accounting screen, rather than a continuous-year operating forecast.
after.zh: 经济性结果是在参考情景分布中合格的服务之间，随价格变化而改变的选择。资源时间测试中的适用失败，使这些价格不能直接作为所观察周工作负载的参与报价。等待和漏期估值均被明确改变；合同违约罚款、应用检查点成本与实际硬件老化仍未定价。独立年度序列提供条件性核算筛选，并非全年连续运行预测。

before.en: The main implication is that a workload assumption must travel with its downstream conclusions. Explicitly limiting permission to 5–20% of offered work produced single-event offers of only 2.95–11.80 kW in this model. Larger values required broader batch participation or a changed business mix. This connects production workload characterisation<sup>20</sup> to the commitment question raised by field demonstrations<sup>3</sup> and scheduling studies,<sup>5–18</sup> without treating a candidate low-priority pool as an observed demand-response resource.
before.zh: 主要启示是，工作负载假设必须与下游结论始终对应。将获准份额明确限制在总投入工作的 5%–20%，本模型的单次承诺仅为 2.95–11.80 kW。更大数值需要扩大批处理参与或改变业务构成。这将生产工作负载刻画<sup>20</sup>与现场示范<sup>3</sup>及调度研究<sup>5–18</sup>提出的承诺问题连接起来，同时避免将低优先级候选池当作已观察到的需求响应资源。

after.en: The main operational finding is that preserving how often jobs arrive can still overstate the transferability of a grid commitment. At unchanged weekly eligible work, a 2.95-kW request passed every chronological submission-count realisation but failed in 49 of 80 matched resource-time-weighted realisations. Each failed realisation contained an hour in which the baseline itself offered too little reducible power. This identifies a concrete decision error: accepting a contract because it passed a count-based workload test, despite inadequate power in the workload’s low-supply hours. The result connects production workload characterisation<sup>20,28</sup> to the commitment question raised by field demonstrations<sup>3</sup> and scheduling studies.<sup>5–19</sup>
after.zh: 最主要的运行发现是：即便保留作业到达次数，仍可能高估电网承诺的适用性。保持各周可参与工作总量不变时，2.95 kW 请求在所有原序提交次数实现中通过，却在 80 个配对的资源时间加权实现中失败 49 次。每个失败实现都存在一个基线本身无法提供足够可削功率的小时。这识别出一种具体决策错误：仅因合同通过次数驱动的工作负载测试便接受它，尽管实际工作量的供给低谷不足以履约。该结果将生产工作负载描述<sup>20,28</sup>与现场展示<sup>3</sup>及调度研究<sup>5–19</sup>提出的承诺问题联系起来。

before.en: The additional operating insight concerns which obligation should change when a request fails. Under corrected recovery control, low offered utilisation can leave insufficient immediate reducible power, while tight deadlines can make task completion the binding service condition. Extra GPU allocation alone did not restore the full request in those deadline controls. Requiring zero deadline loss changed the selected reference eight-hour offer and improved its descriptive transfer to observed production timing. This complements prior distinctions between eligible and dependable workload power<sup>19</sup> by testing the service standard attached to a repeated offer. It does not establish a new optimal controller or a universal physical capacity law.
before.zh: 新增的运营认识在于：请求失败时，应该调整哪一项义务。在修正后的恢复控制下，较低工作供给利用率可能意味着当前可削减功率不足，而紧期限可能使任务完成成为约束服务的主要条件。仅增加 GPU 分配未能在这些期限对照中恢复全额请求。要求零期限违约改变了参考八小时方案选出的报价，并改善了它在真实生产时序下的描述性迁移表现。这通过检验重复报价所附带的服务标准，补充了既有研究对可参与工作功率与可靠减负的区分。<sup>19</sup> 它并不确立新的最优控制器或普适的物理容量规律。

after.en: A failed controller test also requires care in deciding what to change. The same-scenario checks distinguish a necessary instantaneous shortage from a deadline-constrained infeasible programme and from a failure for which a feasible full-information schedule exists. Only the last points directly to unused scheduling or information opportunities; it does not by itself establish a realizable causal policy. Conversely, adding GPU capacity cannot repair a shortage of reducible baseline power and did not restore the tight-deadline diagnostic. Local grid refinement further showed that the earlier reference derating under zero loss was not stable. Commitment choices must therefore rest on independently tested requests and explicit failure mechanisms, rather than a universal penalty assigned to stricter service.
after.zh: 面对控制器测试失败，决定改变什么也需要谨慎。同场景核查区分了必要的即时不足、受期限限制而不可行的方案，以及存在完整未来信息可行调度的控制失败。只有最后一种直接指向尚未利用的调度或信息机会；它本身仍不证明存在可实现的因果策略。相反，新增 GPU 容量无法修补基线可削功率不足，也没有恢复紧期限诊断中的可行性。局部网格加密还说明，早期参考情景中零损失导致的降档并不稳定。因此，承诺选择必须依据独立测试的请求与明确的失败机制，而非给更严格服务附加一个普遍容量惩罚。

before.en: Workload permission also changed the local planning and accounting context. Hosting additional PV and increasing the use of an installed system require different calculations, and battery storage changes both opportunities. Their values cannot be added independently.<sup>23–27</sup> Likewise, a constant rigid-power term can cancel in baseline-relative response while still affecting the facility peak, grid integration and economic scaling.
before.zh: 工作授权也改变本地规划和会计背景。新增光伏承载与提高已安装系统的利用需要不同计算，电池储能会改变两种机会，不能将它们的价值独立相加。<sup>23–27</sup> 同样，恒定刚性功率项可在相对基准的响应中相消，却仍影响设施峰值、电网配合及经济缩放。

after.en: Other system effects remain service-specific. Authorising 5–20% of work supported single-event offers of 2.95–11.80 kW in the reference model, while broader permissions required additional business assumptions. At fixed permission, a larger flexible GPU pool increased PV hosting without increasing the tested demand-response offer. Additional PV capacity and improved use of an existing installation are separate planning benefits,<sup>23–27</sup> just as constant rigid power can cancel in a baseline-relative response while remaining relevant to facility demand and cost scaling.
after.zh: 其他系统影响仍取决于具体服务。在参考模型中，授权 5%–20% 工作参与支持 2.95–11.80 kW 的单次事件报价，更宽参与许可需要额外业务假设。在固定工作许可下，更大的灵活 GPU 池提高了光伏接纳量，却没有提高所测需求响应报价。增加光伏装机与改善现有装机利用程度是不同的规划收益；<sup>23–27</sup> 同样，恒定刚性功率虽然在相对基线的响应中抵消，却仍影响设施需求与成本折算。

before.en: The economic distinction is equally consequential. Fixed access fees largely explained the original unit-cost penalty at low eligibility, so that penalty should not be presented as a new operational mechanism. Once access is free or shared, complete-ledger costs still distinguish duration products and their required tariffs. Operators should therefore compare qualified annual net values, including the option not to participate, rather than rank services solely by a threshold per offered kilowatt. Waiting prices and loss valuations remain assumptions; the calculation identifies what compensation would be required under them, not whether a real operator will accept it.
before.zh: 经济上的区分同样影响决策。固定接入费用解释了原分析中低参与比例的多数单位成本惩罚，因此不应把这种分摊关系写成新的运行机制。接入免费或共享后，完整账本的成本仍能区分时长产品及其所需价格。运营者应比较经过资格检验的年度净值，并纳入不参与的选项，而不能仅按每报价千瓦的门槛给服务排序。等待价格与损失估值仍是假设；计算识别的是在这些假设下需要何种补偿，而不是真实运营者一定会接受。

after.en: Economic assessment should expose the operating quantities before assigning prices. Waiting and missed-work exposure can be inspected independently of their valuations. The preferred duration can change when waiting is free, while a common access fee affects entry rather than the ranking of two participating services. Comparing annual net values, including non-participation, avoids confusing a small unit-cost threshold with the most valuable contract. The refined capacity ratio changes the tariff boundary as well, so an economic coefficient should not be reported more precisely than the operating choice on which it depends.
after.zh: 经济评估应先展示运行量，再赋予价格。等待与漏期暴露可以独立于估值进行检查。当等待免费时，优选时长可能改变；共同接入费用则影响是否进入市场，而非两个参与服务的相对排序。比较包括不参与在内的年度净值，可以避免把较低单位成本门槛误认为最有价值的合同。加密后的容量比也改变了补偿边界，因此经济系数的解释不能比它所依赖的运行选择更精确。

before.en: For planning, the useful output is a conditional commitment: eligible jobs, deadline standard, installed allocation, capacity and call arrangement, accompanied by delivery evidence and a recalculable cost ledger. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>29,30</sup> The matched last-call check also shows why programme failure should not automatically be attributed to cumulative recovery damage. Changes in job timing and service obligations need direct tests, and a candidate should be reduced or withheld when those tests do not support it.
before.zh: 对规划而言，有用的产出是一份附带条件的承诺：允许参与的作业、期限标准、已有硬件分配、容量与调用安排，并同时提供交付证据及可重新计价的账本。这与其他行动跨时段耦合资源的容量评估相一致。<sup>29,30</sup> 最后一次调用的配对核对也说明，不能自动将整组调用失败归因于恢复造成的累积损害。工作时序与服务义务变化需要直接检验；检验不支持时，应降低或暂不采用该候选承诺。

after.en: For planners and operators, the useful output is a conditional commitment with a declared workload, baseline, service standard, capacity and call arrangement. Its delivery evidence and operating ledger must be re-evaluated when the timing structure changes. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose decisions are coupled over time.<sup>29,30</sup> A larger nominal flexible share, more recovery hardware or cheaper access cannot substitute for that assessment.
after.zh: 对规划者和运营者，有用的输出是明确工作负载、基线、服务标准、容量与调用安排的条件性承诺。当时间结构变化时，交付证据与运行账本需要重新评估。这与其他决策在时间上相互耦合的资源容量评估相一致。<sup>29,30</sup> 更高名义柔性比例、更多恢复硬件或更便宜的接入都不能代替这项评估。

before.en: The evidence remains conditional on hourly divisible jobs, synthetic deadlines and permissions, a constant rigid-load proxy and a small board-power calibration. The five eligibility scenarios share template scaling; the structural controls and eight observed timing weeks broaden this evidence without making it an industry workload census. The timing transfer preserves submission counts, not actual runtimes, job dependencies or production service agreements. No application pause–checkpoint–restart sequence was measured. Selection and confirmation were separated, but all probability bounds are pointwise and all capacities belong to finite candidate grids. Four-call episodes and independent annual draws do not establish continuous-year performance. These boundaries limit numerical transfer and any claim of universal superiority over existing approaches.
before.zh: 证据仍以按小时划分的可分工作、合成期限和参与许可、恒定刚性负荷代理及小规模板卡功率校准为条件。五档参与比例情景共用模板缩放；结构对照和八个真实时序周拓宽了证据，但不使其成为行业工作负荷普查。时序迁移保留提交计数，不保留真实运行时长、作业依赖或生产服务协议。我们没有测量应用的暂停—检查点—恢复过程。候选选择与确认虽然分离，但所有概率界均为逐点界，所有容量均来自有限候选网格。四次调用阶段与独立年度抽样不能证明全年连续表现。这些边界限制了数值外推，也限制了相对现有方法普遍占优的主张。

after.en: The evidence is conditional on hourly divisible work, synthetic deadlines and permissions, a fixed rigid-load proxy and a small board-power calibration. Observed task resource-time preserves submission-weight heterogeneity but is not sensor-measured GPU activity, production deadlines or application pause–checkpoint–restart validation. Eight observed weeks with ten synthetic realisations each are not 80 independent production weeks. The earlier PI statistics are relaxed planning envelopes; the new exact-window feasibility checks establish scenario-level possibilities and impossibilities, not a causal capacity certificate. Qualification bounds are pointwise, candidate grids are finite and annual accounts combine independent series. These limits define where the reported commitment and price comparisons can be used.
after.zh: 证据以小时级可分割工作、合成期限与许可、固定刚性负荷代理和小规模板卡功率标定为条件。实际任务资源时间保留提交权重的异质性，但不等于传感器测得的 GPU 忙碌活动、生产期限或应用暂停—检查点—重启验证。八个观察周各十次合成实现，不等于八十个独立生产周。早期 PI 统计量属于放松模型的规划界限；新增严格作业时间窗可行性检验建立的是情景内的可能与不可能，而非因果容量资格。资格概率界为逐项保证，候选网格有限，年度核算组合独立序列。这些限制界定了承诺与价格比较的适用范围。

before.en: The PI programme maximised R separately for each scenario. We summarised these maxima using an exact-binomial nonparametric tolerance lower bound at reliability 0.95 and confidence 0.95.<sup>33</sup> With 100 scenarios, the second-smallest optimum supported this statement with achieved confidence 0.96292. The selected controller offers were independently tested using one-sided 95% Wilson probability lower bounds;<sup>34,35</sup> qualification required a lower bound of at least 0.95. This probability concerns all delivery and service criteria together.
before.zh: PI 程序分别最大化各情景的 R，再用可靠性 0.95、置信度 0.95 的精确二项非参数容忍下界汇总。<sup>33</sup> 在 100 个情景下，第二小的最优值以实际 0.96292 的置信度支持该陈述。所选控制器承诺采用单侧 95% Wilson 概率下界独立检验，<sup>34,35</sup> 资格要求下界至少 0.95。这项概率对应所有交付与服务标准同时满足。

after.en: The earlier PI programme maximised R under cumulative class-release and class-deadline constraints. These are necessary aggregate conditions, but are a relaxation when job windows cross: work executed for an earlier, later-deadline job can satisfy a cumulative due-work inequality for a different job. Its retained optima therefore define relaxed planning envelopes, not generally job-feasible capacities. Their second order statistic among 100 scenarios is a 95%/95% tolerance statistic of that relaxed quantity, with achieved confidence 0.96292.<sup>33</sup> It does not guarantee feasible work scheduling. Controller offers instead use completed queue simulations on independent seeds; their joint delivery-and-service probability is assessed by a one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound, required to reach 0.95.<sup>34,35</sup> The new feasibility diagnostics below use each work group’s own release and deadline.
after.zh: 早期 PI 程序在累计类别释放量与累计类别到期量约束下最大化 R。这些是必要的汇总条件，但当作业时间窗交叉时构成放松：为一个较早释放、较晚到期的作业完成的工作，可能满足另一个作业的累计到期不等式。因此，保留的最优值给出放松模型的规划界限，并非一般都能满足实际作业时间窗的容量。100 个情景中的第二顺序统计量，是该放松量在 95%/95% 条件下的容忍统计量，实际达到的置信度为 0.96292。<sup>33</sup> 它不保证存在可行作业调度。控制器报价则来自独立种子上的完整队列模拟；交付与服务联合概率用单侧 95% Wilson 下界评价，要求达到 0.95。<sup>34,35</sup> 以下新增可行性诊断使用每个工作组自身的释放时间与期限。

before.en: The causal controller retained the six-hour robust MPC, historical-arrival uncertainty envelope and objective weights of the earlier implementation. It observed only released jobs, current queue state and the declared forecast. Its event cap required at least 95% delivery. Because the rebound criterion divides recovery overshoot by actual peak delivered power, the corrected recovery cap used 0.25 × 0.95 × requested power rather than 0.25 × requested power. Continuous actions were rounded towards the feasible side when converted to float32. This electrical cap does not guarantee deadline feasibility. Candidates at 50%, 75%, 90% and 100% of the development PI lower bound were evaluated separately; no monotonicity between candidates was assumed.
before.zh: 因果控制器保留此前实现中的六小时鲁棒 MPC、历史到达量不确定性包络和目标权重，只观察已释放作业、当前队列状态及声明的预测。事件功率上限要求至少交付 95%。由于反弹指标以实际最大削减功率为分母，修正后的恢复上限采用 0.25 × 0.95 × 承诺功率，而非 0.25 × 承诺功率。连续动作转换为 float32 时向可行一侧舍入。这项电气上限不保证截止时间可行性。开发 PI 下界的 50%、75%、90% 和 100% 候选分别接受检验，不假定候选之间具有单调性。

before.en: **a,** Development-selected, independently confirmed eight-hour offers at 16-h start spacing, under 1% or zero total missed work. before.en: A PI optimisation finds the largest feasible request for one fully known scenario. With 100 scenarios, the second-smallest optimum is the exact-binomial lower tolerance bound for 95% reliability at at least 95% confidence (achieved confidence 0.96292). A controller offer is a different object: a candidate fixed on development data and tested on 300 independent scenario seeds. The one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound must reach 0.95. The offer and PI tolerance bound use different samples and statistical constructions, so their ordering in a plot is not an information advantage. Offers are selected from a finite grid and are not continuous maxima. Notice comparisons hold the request fixed and test paired binary outcomes.
before.zh: PI 优化寻找一个完整已知情景中的最大可行请求。在 100 个情景中，第二小的最优值构成可靠性 95%、置信度至少 95% 的精确二项容忍下界，实际达到的置信度为 0.96292。控制器承诺是另一对象：在开发数据上固定候选，再用 300 个独立情景种子检验，其单侧 95% Wilson 下界必须达到 0.95。承诺与 PI 容忍下界使用不同样本和统计构造，图中二者的高低不代表信息优势。承诺来自有限网格，并非连续最大值。通知比较固定请求，检验配对二元结果。

after.en: The earlier PI programme maximised R under cumulative class-release and class-deadline constraints. These are necessary aggregate conditions, but are a relaxation when job windows cross: work executed for an earlier, later-deadline job can satisfy a cumulative due-work inequality for a different job. Its retained optima therefore define relaxed planning envelopes, not generally job-feasible capacities. Their second order statistic among 100 scenarios is a 95%/95% tolerance statistic of that relaxed quantity, with achieved confidence 0.96292.<sup>33</sup> It does not guarantee feasible work scheduling. Controller offers instead use completed queue simulations on independent seeds; their joint delivery-and-service probability is assessed by a one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound, required to reach 0.95.<sup>34,35</sup> The new feasibility diagnostics below use each work group’s own release and deadline.
after.zh: 早期 PI 程序在累计类别释放量与累计类别到期量约束下最大化 R。这些是必要的汇总条件，但当作业时间窗交叉时构成放松：为一个较早释放、较晚到期的作业完成的工作，可能满足另一个作业的累计到期不等式。因此，保留的最优值给出放松模型的规划界限，并非一般都能满足实际作业时间窗的容量。100 个情景中的第二顺序统计量，是该放松量在 95%/95% 条件下的容忍统计量，实际达到的置信度为 0.96292。<sup>33</sup> 它不保证存在可行作业调度。控制器报价则来自独立种子上的完整队列模拟；交付与服务联合概率用单侧 95% Wilson 下界评价，要求达到 0.95。<sup>34,35</sup> 以下新增可行性诊断使用每个工作组自身的释放时间与期限。
